tags.description: Up to 10 tags/keywords that capture the essence of the article

claim.description: The single thing the article asks the reader to accept, in one plain sentence, including any answer its headline withholds

support.description: What the claim rests on, most load-bearing first, at most five, one short phrase each

padding.description: Material the claim does not rest on, at most five, one short phrase each; empty if there is none

headline_gap.description: Whether the article's own title states the claim, overstates it, or withholds it

source_depth.description: Whether the supplied text is the full article body or only a headline and a line or two of blurb
